# omni_model_git (Resource)

Connects a model to a git repository.

This configures the connection itself: repository, branch, authentication and pull request policy. The model content that git then versions is not managed here.

Credentials are never returned by the API, so Terraform cannot detect a deploy key or token changed outside configuration. They are also stored in plain text in state, so treat state as secret material.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `clone_url` (String) Clone URL of the repository. Use SSH (`git@github.com:org/repo.git`) with `ssh` auth, HTTPS with `https_token` or `github_app`.
- `model_id` (String) The model to connect.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) `ssh` for a deploy key, the default. `https_token` for a deploy token or PAT. `github_app` for a GitHub App installation, github.com only.
- `base_branch` (String) Target branch for Omni pull requests. Defaults to `main`.
- `branch_per_pull_request` (Boolean) When `true`, every pull request creates a branch in Omni.
- `commit_signing_committer_email` (String) Verified email of the GitHub user owning the signing key. `github_app` auth only, and must be set or cleared together with the committer name.
- `commit_signing_committer_name` (String) Display name written into signed commits. `github_app` auth only, and must be set or cleared together with the committer email.
- `deploy_key_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase for the deploy key, if it has one.
- `deploy_private_key` (String, Sensitive) Deploy key private key, for `ssh` auth. Never returned by the API, so drift on it cannot be detected.
- `git_follower` (Boolean) When `true`, the model follows the repository and cannot be edited in Omni. Use this for an environment that mirrors another.
- `git_service_provider` (String) Which git host. `auto` detects it from the clone URL.
- `github_app_installation_id` (String) GitHub App installation ID, for `github_app` auth.
- `model_path` (String) Path within the repository where the model lives.
- `require_pull_request` (String) Whether model changes must go through a pull request. `always` is the setting to use where model content is reviewed.
- `ssh_url` (String) SSH URL of the repository, where it differs from the clone URL.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Deploy token or personal access token, for `https_token` auth.
- `web_url` (String) Browser URL of the repository, used for links back to it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tracks `model_id`: a model has at most one git configuration.
